findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 30 requests to 12 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 6.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 1.1 MB (16%) came from third-party domains, 562 kB of it from services classified as tracking (15 requests).

5 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), mrf.io (Marfeel, analytics), newsroom.bi (Marfeel, analytics), privacymanager.io (LiveRamp, advertising).
1 cookies were set by third-party domains (5 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 4 requests were blocked. The page still made 30 requests to 12 third-party domains, including 6 tracking services in our list.
